name: Altruistic Gunslinger (Grit)
body:
Prerequisite(s): grit class feature or Amateur Gunslinger feat, base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s): When you hand an ally a firearm, you can spend 2 grit points to grant that ally proficiency with the firearm you hand her and the Amateur Gunslinger feat along with one grit point. This ally loses these benefits after taking one shot with that firearm or if 24 hours pass.
